models.M0: NL + CapabilityIR -> TaskIR (target = deterministic strict lowering of the record's skeleton)
models.M1: NL + CapabilityIR -> Skeleton JSON -> deterministic lowering

budget.policy: identical optimizer steps; max_steps set by M0's 2-epoch plan, M1 runs the same steps (effective epochs ~1.78)

training.optimizer: paged_adamw_32bit, lr 2e-4 cosine, warmup 3%, eff.batch 16, seq 2048

evaluation: frozen evaluator on dev_sft/test_sft (unseen-family) + test_samefamily; grouped by depth 1/2-3/4-6/7+ and mutation presence; tau3-unused = external final only
